correctness.rationale: For any a,b,c,d>=0 the zero-only occurrence counts have differences f_l-f_(l+1)=#{g>=l}, recovering the four gap lengths including zero lengths. P3=z^(b+c)G_aG_d reads the inner sum and the unordered outer pair via triangular coefficients and degree; the remaining unordered inner pair follows. Reversal leaves exactly 1+1_(a!=d)1_(b!=c) candidates. Swapping inner gaps changes P1 by (G_a-G_d)(G_b-G_c), nonzero precisely when the two candidates are inequivalent. Independently re-enumerated literal substring histograms and reversal fibers for 8855 words of lengths 3..22; all 2640 sparse fibers and enrichment were correct. Finite tests corroborate the complete algebraic proof and do not prove it alone.
residual_risks: Only noise-free complete multisets and known Hamming weight exactly three are proved; no claim for weight four or noisy channels.

value.rationale: Weight-three words are a natural minimal multirun model of substring-composition reconstruction. The theorem resolves exact ambiguity under a genuinely selective measurement channel uniformly at every length, and identifies exactly the extra one-count observation required to resolve orientation; this is not an arbitrary finite enumerative slice or a mechanical corollary of full-spectrum algorithms.
residual_risks: Does not establish minimality of the selected observation set or robustness to errors.

final_claim: For any three-one binary word w=0^a1 0^b1 0^c1 0^d, the composition substrings containing exactly zero and three ones identify exactly 1+1_(a!=d)1_(b!=c) reversal classes; adding all one-one substrings identifies w uniquely up to reversal, without the two-one layer.
limitations: Known Hamming weight exactly three, exact complete substring compositions with multiplicity, linear substrings, not bit complementation or cyclic equivalence.
No proof of smallest sufficient set of count layers, no robustness.
Historical originality is best-of-knowledge, not a certificate of comprehensive priority.
